value.rationale: Resolves exactly the parity gap left open by the determinant-sign method for disjoint obligate predation cycles in the 2026 classification. Supplies a strictly positive perturbation direction and a sharp positive lower bound from intrinsic mortality, and constructs feasible examples realizing sharpness for every even partition.
